reveal.use_when: the thing being explained is first named or introduced (the first actor is the hero, up to 3 more stand beside it)

inside.use_when: what something holds, is made of or has inside (a cloud holds water, lungs hold air, a phone holds a battery); actors: the container, then what is inside (a cloud needs no second actor: its water is built in)

compare.use_when: two things set side by side, especially by size (a raindrop vs a cloud droplet, the sun vs the earth); ratio = the second's size / the first's

many.use_when: huge numbers of something small (billions of droplets, millions of cells, thousands of people); number = the count as said, e.g. "billions"

force.use_when: something is pushed, lifted, pulled or makes something fall or rise (warm air lifts droplets, gravity pulls rain down); actors: the thing moved, then the cause (heat, an arrow, wind...); direction = where it moves

transform.use_when: one thing becomes, merges into or turns into another (droplets merge into a raindrop, water turns to ice, savings grow into wealth); actors: from, to

flow.use_when: a process, a chain of steps or cause and effect (salary -> savings -> investing; seed -> plant -> fruit); actors in order

cycle.use_when: a loop that repeats (the water cycle, a habit loop, day and night); actors in order around the loop

scale.use_when: an amount or quantity piling up (5 lakh kg, ₹10 lakh, 2 tonnes of gold); number = the amount exactly as said, digits where spoken as a number

wrong.use_when: a myth or wrong idea the speaker rejects (it is NOT one big blob of water), optionally followed by the right one; actors: wrong, then right

location.use_when: a real place on Earth (a city, country, river, mountain); place = its name, lat/lon = its coordinates

worlds.sky: weather, clouds, rain, air, birds, flight, the outdoors seen from above
worlds.space: planets, stars, the sun, the moon, atoms and anything cosmic
worlds.macro: the microscopic or the tiny: droplets, molecules, bubbles, particles, chemistry
worlds.body: inside the human body: blood, cells, organs, germs, health, medicine
worlds.ocean: under water: sea life, the ocean, rivers, fish, diving
worlds.room: everyday life indoors: a home, light through a window, dust, household things
worlds.studio: money, business, work, technology, products, ideas, habits, psychology; the default for anything abstract
worlds.city: cities, rent, housing, traffic, jobs, the economy of places
